metadata.description: AI Mastery capstone projects — CLI reference validation and Jira-sourced release notes

plugins.name: cli-validator
plugins.description: Validates a documented CLI reference guide against a build's actual CLI manifest — classifies every command as unchanged, updated, new, deprecated, renamed, or behavior-changed.

plugins.name: release-notes-generator
plugins.description: Generates reader-facing release notes from a bundled snapshot of real Jira tickets via a local MCP server. Includes only completed work and separately flags what's still in progress.
